title: Transactions and Interactive Transactions
description: Use Prisma transactions and interactive transactions to ensure data consistency across multiple operations.

data.text: Transactions ensure that a series of database operations either all succeed or all fail together. Prisma supports both interactive transactions and sequential operations within a transaction.
Interactive transactions use `$transaction` with an array of operations or a callback. The callback form is preferred for complex logic.

data.content: Transfer credits between two users atomically.

data.title: Note
data.text: Prisma interactive transactions are not supported with SQLite in some versions. Use PostgreSQL for full transaction support in production.
